archimate:CourseOfAction.name: 7. Modernising our NHB systems​
archimate:CourseOfAction.documentation:
Ensuring NHB colleagues have modern technology and data they can trust to better support the projects and fund management.​
Added as a priority following CLT in September. A need to understand core requirements (including impact on ways of working and outcomes) for a new portfolio management solution.​
Level 2 capabilities are: Guarantees​ Debt​ Equity​ Investment operations​ Portfolio, Programme and Project management ​ Fund Management ​ Account and contract management ​
